Founder: Thanks for jumping on. So we're building an app that chases late invoices for design studios. It will automatically send reminders and our tool plugs into your bank.
Priya: Oh, I love that. That's a great idea, honestly.
Founder: Would you use something like that?
Priya: Yeah, probably. I'd definitely use it if it was cheap.
Founder: How much would you pay for it per month?
Priya: I don't know, maybe twenty euros? People would pay for that, for sure.
Founder: Do you think other studios have the same problem?
Priya: Sure, everyone hates chasing money.
Founder: Great. Our app also has a dashboard with all your clients.
Priya: Sounds great. Keep me posted when it launches.
